verdict.rationale: Render's first-party marketing explicitly states "Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards" (render-docs-20), and its docs list a Custom domains feature (render-docs-6). Together these cover the free, every-domain and wildcard parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that certificates renew automatically, in-depth documentation of certificate provisioning and wildcard setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
